description: This file contains Gatsby.js Node APIs for creating pages, nodes, and webpack configuration, specific to the FreeCodeCamp project.

methods.name: onCreateNode
methods.description: Creates a 'slug' node field for MarkdownRemark nodes, excluding LICENSE files.

methods.name: createPages
methods.description: Generates pages based on GraphQL data, handling missing API keys, and creating superblock intro pages.

methods.name: onCreateWebpackConfig
methods.description: Configures Webpack with plugins and fallbacks, including Monaco editor support during certain build stages.

methods.name: onCreateBabelConfig
methods.description: Sets Babel plugins for proposal syntax features.
